📋 *Slack Channel Cleanup Plan*

Hey everyone — doing a sweep of public channels to tidy up. Here's the plan:

*What counts as "stale":* No messages in 14+ days.

*Threshold:* ≤4 members = small team (archive). 5+ members = larger team (nudge first).

---

*Stale channels — will archive (small team):*
• `#infra-weekly` — 3 members, last message ~24 days ago (June 26). Low activity, small group.
• `#design-v1` — 4 members, last message ~23 days ago (June 27). Purpose notes it's superseded by `#design`.

*Stale channels — will nudge (larger team):*
• `#ml-experiments` — 7 members, last message ~22 days ago (June 28).
• `#qa-standup` — 6 members, last message ~19 days ago (July 1).

*Skipping (protected or still active):*
• `#deploy-alerts` — automated webhook target, channel purpose says "Do not archive."
• `#launch-retro` — only 7 days inactive, still within reasonable range.
• All other channels — last activity within the past week.

Will start archiving and nudging shortly. If I'm wrong about any of these, speak up!

👋 Hey #ml-experiments! This channel has been quiet for about 22 days — last message was on June 28 from Priya about revisiting the LoRA fine-tuning approach.

You've got 7 members here. If there are updates to share or experiments to discuss, feel free to post! Otherwise, if this channel has run its course, consider archiving it to keep the workspace tidy. No pressure either way — just a friendly nudge. 🙂

👋 Hey #qa-standup! This channel has been quiet for about 19 days — last message was on July 1 from Rachel with a P1 status update.

You've got 6 members here. If there are ongoing QA updates or test pipeline status to share, this is the place! If the standup format has moved elsewhere or this channel is no longer needed, consider winding it down to keep things clean. Just a friendly nudge! 🙂
